gate: First observed post-update live checkpoint with every correction and auxiliary/preservation response token,including EOS,at probability>=0.9. No validation or test output chooses it.
predictions: Gradient-selected low-rate fits reach the observed confidence gate in fewer updates than random seed11 and LoRA;this need not mean lower total cost.
Earlier adequate checkpoints reduce some fixed-step collateral damage;zero unrelated errors or unchanged transfer are not assumed.
Matched grad-enabled and no-grad evaluations agree on target argmax at the same state;the known high-rate last update itself destabilizes its correction.
Discovery is inexpensive relative to the old total sparse lifecycle,but total sparse cost may remain above LoRA because attachment/export/checking also count.
fixed: Same original inputs,supports,FP16 base/FP32 trainables,Adam rates,cycling,loss scale,clipping,and50 updates. Continue after the first adequate checkpoint solely to recover the identical50-step reference. No norm/KL objective is added.
controls: Require all final trainable tensors,all50 historical training rows,live and merged final teacher logits,and final merged generations to exactly reproduce their parents. Otherwise report a failed trajectory-control check,not a stopping advantage.
execution_audit: At selected and final checkpoints compare grad-enabled and no-grad teacher outputs. For the known high-rate failure additionally audit the same final sampled prompt before and after the last update,and save parameters,gradient and Adam moments.
cost: Rerun discovery once per case and require frozen selected supports. Report discovery,training,monitoring,serialization and diagnostic costs separately. Counterfactual time-to-stop excludes the continued control suffix. No production throughput claim follows from a single observed trajectory.
useful_result: For the normal low-rate conditions,the selected-neuron early endpoint should retain>=7/8 complete transfer answers and have no new unambiguous preservation error on qualitative review. Its correction/preservation tradeoff and discovery-inclusive measured prefix cost must improve on the same stopping rule for random seed11 and official LoRA before advancing to fresh confirmation. Report all fixed50 and early outputs. The high-rate request is a diagnostic,not an extra tuned candidate.
limits: Two exposed development facts;single deliberately strong clean random seed. No paper superiority,novel loss or robust recipe. Existing exact-score labels remain primary;semantic aliases and ambiguous questions are reviewed separately. Auxiliary targets are unchanged even where the base initially misses them.
